_doc: Zone art for Raza (rid 300), docs/adr/0003 pass 3. Each building lists a region (blockout glTF metres [x0, z0, x1, z1], x east, z south) whose blockout faces are rebuilt as art by tools/blender/build_zone_art.py and hidden from the rendered blockout by tools/ue/build_world.py (the full blockout stays as collision). Ground-level floors in a region stay in the blockout. `materials` limits an entry to those textures; a face belongs to the first entry that takes it, so broad entries (the town wall) go last. kind "water": the faces become a water surface over a sunken bed. `scatter`: ground decoration per floor texture (tools/environment/scatter.py). grid_m: displacement grid for that entry (default 0.25 m; coarser for long walls).
